checks: first tap reveals the opening line without advancing
layout: dialogue ~28%, quick bar and floating buttons inside the screen and above the box
tapping the background (not the box) also advances
long-press hides UI; the restoring tap does not advance
swipe up opens the backlog; closing keeps the line
tap S hints, long-press S quick-saves with a toast; neither advances
dragging (≡) snaps it to the nearest side edge without advancing
idle 3 s fades buttons to 40%; menu opens and closes from the background
AUTO advances by itself and toggles off
reload + continue preserves line, flags and sprites
correct callback and complete ending
restart resets flags; SKIP fast-forwards and stops at the choice
